title: File exceeds 1000 lines (2117 lines)
detail: File is 2117 lines, well above the 1000-line maintainability threshold. Large files typically contain many unrelated concerns and make code review and change-isolation harder. Suggested fix: split into smaller modules by responsibility.

title: Broad exception caught (bare `except Exception`) at 1 sites (L1907)
detail: Several `except Exception` handlers log and continue without re-raising. While marked as best-effort, broad catches make it harder to track unexpected failure modes in production. Where possible, catch the specific exception types the called API documents. Suggested fix: refine catch clauses to known exception types.

title: Unnecessary `pass` in abstract/stub methods (10 instances)
detail: Abstract method stubs or pure interface declarations contain a bare `pass` statement alongside a docstring or `raise NotImplementedError`. The `pass` is redundant when a docstring or `raise` already makes the function body non-empty. Suggested fix: remove the redundant `pass` statements.
